Proves AR-6's `inRange` operator on a `date` field with both boundaries inclusive — the third inclusivity combination covered (alongside 040's inclusive/exclusive and 041's exclusive/inclusive), demonstrating SEM-4's explicit-flags mechanism independent of any one assumed default. As with 040, AG Grid's native `inRange` wire shape carries no inclusivity flags, so this fixture uses the `customFilters` (OQ-11) extension point to inject a `rangeComparisonNode` with explicit `fromInclusive: true, toInclusive: true` (see the category README).
